scope_note: Everything. A service is in scope if it runs the target's code or stores the target's data regardless of vendor hostname (Heroku apps, AWS ALB origins, etc. are first-party). All *.amenitiz.io and *.amenitiz.com hosts in scope. crt.sh surfaced extra in-scope hosts on amenitiz.io (bookingsuite, get, *.infra, awsinfra-*). No new registrable domains encountered.
session_goal: Maximum impact: P1 / PII / High+Critical CVSS. Exploit phase.
recon_status: Surface mapped. EXPLOIT BLOCKER: Cloudflare managed challenge (4546-4547 byte 'Attention Required' pages) stands on all app paths of every CF-fronted host (booking engine, app, import-bookings/leadgen deep paths). The agent proxy IP cannot pass the JS challenge and browser-UA spoofing is policy-denied (Bot Check Circumvention). Only non-CF hosts (pay/pay-s Go gateways, pay-t ALB) and public DNS are curl-reachable.
ruled_out: mcp-cell.amenitiz.io - NOT dangling: CNAME to internal AWS ELB (private IPs). Repurposed as F001 info-disclosure finding.
reCAPTCHA site key on signup page - public by design, not a finding
app.amenitiz.io /graphql,/api,/up,/sidekiq,/rails/info/routes - 404, not exposed at root paths

import-bookings CORS: reflects arbitrary Origin BUT no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials:true (confirmed on GET + OPTIONS preflight). Browser blocks cross-origin read of cookie-authed responses. Low/non-finding per task rubric.
leadgen CORS: static ACAO http://localhost:3000, does NOT reflect attacker origin. Non-finding.
pay.amenitiz.io Go gateway: only /status responds (200 'ok'); all other paths return Go '404 page not found'. No routes discoverable without signed requests.
pay-t.amenitiz.io ALB: fixed 503 (162 bytes) for every Host header tested (app/booking/pay hosts) - dead ALB, no listener rules, NOT a CF-origin-bypass path.
infra sub-subdomains (dev/qa/prod/staging-3.infra, awsinfra-*): TLS handshake failure / timeout - dead/unreachable.
bookingsuite/get CF 1014 - see takeover candidates in pending_decisions (not completable here).

open_threads.title: Multi-tenant booking-engine IDOR (cross-tenant guest PII)
open_threads.detail: UNTESTED - BLOCKED. distribution-secure/your-hotel/fallback/leadgen-aws are all behind Cloudflare managed challenge; every app path (/en, /api/v1/establishments/{id}, /graphql, /establishments/{id}, *.json) returns the 4546-4547 byte CF 'Attention Required' challenge to the proxy IP. Cannot reach object-ID endpoints via curl. Note: distribution-secure robots.txt 302-redirects to a verygoodproxy.com (VGS payment proxy) sandbox - payment card data path. REQUIRES a real browser from a clean/residential IP (or CF allowlisting of the tester IP) to pass the challenge and test IDOR. This is the highest-value thread and remains open pending that access.

open_threads.title: app.amenitiz.io PMS authenticated surface
open_threads.detail: Self-service signup POST /en/users gated by reCAPTCHA v3; deep app paths also behind CF challenge. Needs a manually-registered account (browser) to reach authenticated PMS API for IDOR + mass-assignment. See pending_decisions.

open_threads.title: Subdomain takeover candidates (get, bookingsuite)
open_threads.detail: get.amenitiz.io -> dangling CNAME 43c436bc164b4a65b829e15b488f3916.unbouncepages.com (Unbounce). bookingsuite.amenitiz.io -> dangling CNAME secure.pageserve.co (PageServe, serves 'Pageserver 404' for unconfigured hosts). Both currently return CF error 1014 (cross-user CNAME banned) = unclaimed dangling state. Cookies _myapp_session/__cf_bm are Domain=amenitiz.io scoped, so a successful takeover would be High (cookie theft/session). NOT confirmed: completing it requires registering an Unbounce/PageServe account and claiming the host; CF-for-SaaS 1014 implies DCV may block it. See pending_decisions.

open_threads.title: mcp.amenitiz.io AI MCP server
open_threads.detail: 403 CF edge block on all paths. mcp-cell (its internal cell) confirmed internal-only ELB. Needs edge bypass/valid auth; blocked same as T1.

Cannot be automated from this environment.
T2 PMS account: app.amenitiz.io signup gated by reCAPTCHA v3 - needs manual browser-based registration of peter.bjorn75@gmail.com (reserved: verification step that cannot be automated).

If the vendor serves attacker content without domain-ownership (DCV) proof, it is a confirmed High takeover. Active-claim step on a live third-party property - hold for user decision.
